source: Synthetic; modeled on a realistic builder mistake. The producer reads §D3, sees `journal: array<...>`, knows about Firestore `arrayUnion`, and reaches for it without re-reading §D3's RMW mandate.

input.verify_line: Unit tests against Firestore emulator: create → get round-trip; update changes only specified fields; findActiveForUser returns the one incident with endedAt == null && deletedAt == null.
input.diff_summary: IncidentRepository.appendJournal uses `updateDoc(ref, { journal: arrayUnion(entry) })` instead of the RMW pattern §D3 mandates.

notes: This is the exact failure mode the §D3 explanatory text exists to prevent. If the cold-reader misses it, the prompt isn't pulling its weight on scope-check #4 (drift from cited design sections). Empirically validated: the round-15 hand-test of the cold-reader against this case caught it as CRITICAL/scope_check 4 with both correct evidence and description matches.
